description: The line plot titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at every 0.1 interval. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," is also a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at every 2.5 interval. The On-policy RL line is represented by a yellow line with triangle markers, the LUFY line by a red line with star markers, and the SFT line by a blue line with diamond markers. The On-policy RL line shows a general increase in accuracy as temperature increases, starting at approximately 65.0 and peaking at around 77.5. The LUFY line exhibits more variability, with accuracy fluctuating between approximately 70.0 and 80.0. The SFT line also shows variability, with accuracy ranging from about 70.0 to 75.0. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions about the cause of the changes observed.
